basis: Ranges are our judgment inside the sourced market ranges for a first-year solo photographer serving local businesses (research/niches/photo.json, data/niche.json service_menu). Business shoot: Thumbtack commercial and local business photography $299 to $645 (average $440, about $198 an hour). Half day: 4 hours at about $150 to $300 an hour (Thumbtack $122 to $364 an hour; ZenBusiness brand day rates start at $800). One-hour shoot and the monthly session: StartCosts event photography $150 to $350 an hour, Thumbtack low-end $122 an hour. Headshots: Thumbtack $216 to $427 for one person, StartCosts $150 to $400; a team session at their place sits in the lower half. Listing photos: StartCosts $100 to $400 a property, ZenBusiness $100 to $300 for 25 to 30 photos, Thumbtack $236 to $394. Drone: Thumbtack example of $150 added for aerial photos.

packages.label: Business shoot
includes: Up to 2 hours at your place, from a shot list we agree first
25 edited photos in an online gallery within 3 days
Sized for your website, Google profile, posts and menus
Written permission to use them on your website, Google profile, posts, menus and ads

packages.label: Half-day shoot
includes: Up to 4 hours at your place: your work, your space, the outside and your team
50 edited photos in an online gallery within 3 days
Headshots for up to 6 people, same light and look
Written permission to use them on your website, Google profile, posts, menus and ads

packages.label: One-hour shoot
includes: 1 hour at your place, from a short shot list
10 edited photos in an online gallery within 3 days
Written permission to use them on your website, Google profile, posts and menus

packages.label: Team headshots
includes: At your place, one backdrop or in your space
2 edited photos for each person, their pick
Same light and look for the whole team
In an online gallery within 3 days

packages.label: Listing photos
includes: 25 to 30 edited photos, inside and out
In your gallery within 24 hours
Sized for the MLS and listing sites

addons.label: Extra hour on site, with its edited photos

care_plans.label: Monthly photo session
includes: 1 hour at your place each month, from a short shot list
10 new edited photos each month, in your gallery within 3 days
What's new comes first: dishes, products, the season, new faces
Month to month: stop any time before the next month
